title: Codelco board calls extraordinary shareholders' meeting for November 5

Codelco board calls extraordinary shareholders’ meeting for November 5
Codelco’s board has called an Extraordinary Shareholders’ Meeting for November 5 following requests from government ministers. The session aims to address inconsistencies found in recent production figures and review ongoing audit results.
The board of Codelco agreed on Oct. 14 to call an Extraordinary Shareholders’ Meeting for November 5, which will be held at the corporation’s facilities in Santiago.
The meeting was requested by the Ministers of Finance and Mining, Jorge Quiroz and Daniel Mas, who act as delegates of the President of the Republic in his capacity as shareholder of Codelco. The request is based on the need to review and analyze information related to inconsistencies detected in production figures for 2024 and 2025.
In response to these issues, Codelco has initiated audits aimed at identifying the source of the inconsistencies and determining appropriate corrective measures.
The upcoming meeting is expected to focus on presenting findings from these audits and discussing potential actions with shareholders.
